_comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/check-tag-hygiene.mjs. Every value is a DEFECT COUNT that must not grow. Re-measured on prod 2026-08-23 08:2x UTC, AFTER 20260919100000/130000 (Phase 1.1/1.3) applied, to absorb one day of unrelated backlog growth from the profession-tag pipeline (is_adult-flagged German profession tags land with no description) and ordinary new-tag image ingestion while this PR chain was in flight. The ratchet fails on regression, never on improvement. Tighten with `node scripts/check-tag-hygiene.mjs --update` after a cleanup lands; never loosen a number to make CI pass.

_notes.duplicate_active_name: 9 is correct, not a backlog: these are the deliberate mat-* sense splits (mat-leather vs leather) excluded by 20260916110000. Going UP means a real twin pair regrew.
_notes.redirect_to_non_canonical: 301s into a 404. PR #2828 fixed this class once and it has regrown to 58; recorded so the 59th is caught, not so 58 is accepted.
_notes.image_without_license: Grew 1167 -> 1215 during Phase 0 and 1215 -> 1251 in the day this PR chain was landing (new tags from the profession pipeline). Phase 3 drives it down.
_notes.image_without_alt: WCAG 1.1.1 on every page rendering a tag image. Phase 3.
_notes.sensitive_without_description: Grew 16 -> 26 from newly-created is_adult German profession tags (e.g. Vedette, Bogenschiessen) landing with no description yet — same pipeline as image_without_license above, not this PR's own regression.
